index.title: AI-gile: your AI dev team, on one board
index.description: AI-gile is a kanban board for AI coding teams. They work while you're having a snooze; you get one short pile of things to decide, test and accept.
hero.h1.html: Your AI dev team, on one board.
hero.alphaTitle: Early and a bit rough: ta for giving it a go!
hero.lede: They build while you sleep. You wake up to one short pile: a few questions, a few things to test, a purple diamond or two. Click, accept, back to your cuppa.
dl.notify: 🔔 Give me a yell when it opens
hero.secondary: Agile, but the team never needs a stand-up coffee. (They do stand-ups anyway, the keen beans.)
pitch.h2: AI-gile in as many words as you reckon
pitch.lede: Pick a length, from one word to 144. Each length is its own description, written for that size. Drag the slider or use the arrow keys.
count.line.html.one: {n} card on the board right now
count.line.html.other: {n} cards on the board right now
f.pile.html: For you holds everything waiting on you, across every project: questions, things to test, jobs only a human can do. Your queue says what's next and how long it'll take.
f.sleep.h: Teams that work while you sleep
f.sleep.p: Each project has a lead and a team of AI agents. Comment on a card and the team wakes up, does the work, and hands it back with steps a knackered human can follow.
f.tester.p: Before anything reaches you, a tester follows the steps in a copy of the app and shows what it saw, with a screenshot. Flick through the ones that passed and accept in a click.
f.proof.p: Every hand-over shows what changed: the files, the diff, the screenshots. No opening every app to see if it's done.
f.chat.p: A Discord-style rail: one icon per project, purple diamonds for what needs you. Message a lead an idea; they turn it into cards and a plan, with a ✅ Go button.
f.tidy.p: Related cards fold into one, muddled titles get fixed, and a token check keeps the code lean. Fewer things to juggle, less to think about.
f.private.li1: The board runs on your own machine and only answers to you.
f.private.li2: Private DMs between mates are end-to-end encrypted.
f.private.li3: No accounts, no trackers, no cookies.
f.lang.p: Over 120 languages, from Dutch, Welsh and Japanese to pirate, Yoda and Klingon, with a quick switch back to English for the developer words.

tl.lede: Real dates and times, in your own time zone. After today it's the plan, with no dates promised.
join.lede: AI-gile is being built by one small human and heaps of patient agents. It's private for now, in a closed alpha with mates. Keen for a go when it opens up?
